item.title: Georgia House adopts Kemp’s income tax cut
item.description: Gov. Brian Kemp is halfway to getting his income tax rate cut approved by the Legislature after the state House passed it in a mostly party-line vote Wednesday. The post Georgia House adopts Kemp’s income tax cut appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.title: Energy Department announces $26.5B loan package for Georgia, Alabama energy projects
item.description: U.S. Secretary of Energy Chris Wright announced that the Department of Energy’s Office of Energy Dominance Financing has closed a $26.5 billion loan package expected to deliver more than $7 billion in electricity cost savings to customers in Georgia and Alabama. The post Energy Department announces $26.5B loan package for Georgia, Alabama energy projects appeared first on The Augusta Press.

item.description: Author and historian Carol Sue Humphrey will present the 2026 Future of the First Amendment Lecture on Tuesday, March 10, at 7 p.m. in the JSAC Coffeehouse on Augusta University’s Summerville Campus.
